website_summary.name: File Explorer Interface
website_summary.description: The website presents a clean and minimalistic interface designed for navigating and managing files within a directory structure.
website_summary.appearance: The website features a modern and simplistic design with a light gray background and white content panels. At the top, there is a navigation bar containing a breadcrumb trail, navigation buttons, a search bar, and filter options. Below the navigation bar, the main content area displays a grid layout indicating "No items found," suggesting an empty directory. The bottom section includes options to create a new folder and clear filters, alongside a status message indicating the number of items currently being viewed.
website_summary.functionality: The website includes several key functionalities: a search bar allows users to find specific files or folders by entering keywords. Filter options enable users to refine their search criteria. Users can switch between grid and list views for better organization. Additionally, there is a feature to create new folders directly from the interface. The status bar at the bottom provides real-time feedback on the number of items displayed.

element_requirement: 1. Search Bar : Text box for entering search queries
2. Filters Button : Button for opening filter options
3. New Folder Button : Button for creating a new folder, located at the bottom of the page
4. Clear Filters Button : Button for clearing applied filter settings
5. Placeholder Card : Displays "No items found" message in grid view
6. New Folder Dialog Card : Card showing the folder creation dialog
7. Footer Card : Displays controls and info about items, like 'New Folder,' 'Clear Filters,' and '0 of 0 items'
8. Layout Toggle : Icon for toggling the layout view
9. Sort Options : Icon for selecting sorting options
10. Images Button : Button to filter by images
11. Documents Button : Button to filter by documents
12. Folder Name Input : Text box for entering the folder name
